title: Demonstrate 2jn's A1 and A5 live: ticfac init + ticfac run on claude in herdr, and one epic via run --cloud, on the merged binary
body: 2jn's A1 was traced by the review and tested with a stand-in child; no run in the epic started from 'ticfac init' then 'ticfac run <epic>' in herdr panes on claude (the run itself used GLM on local subprocesses), and A5's run --cloud is tested only against a fake factory. Run the next epic (t8u) that way and one small epic with --cloud, and record the evidence; this is the fourth epic that closed without the run its acceptance names.
